title: Specifying Reward Functions for RL Without Environment Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2609.15544v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Enabling human stakeholders to specify reward functions that lead to their desired outcomes is a key challenge in deploying reinforcement learning agents. Preference-based methods such as online RLHF can reduce the burden of manual reward design, but they require repeatedly training policies, sampling trajectories from the real world, and eliciting feedback, making them impractical in settings where environment interaction is computationally expensive or unsafe. We introduce Experience-Free Autonomous Reward Specification (EARS), a method for learning reward functions from preferences without environment interaction. Our approach uses a structured LLM-mediated process to construct a small set of expressive reward features from a task description and the environment observation space, then strategically samples imagined trajectories in this feature space and learns feature weights from preferences over the imagined trajectory pairs. translated_title: 无需环境采样的强化学习奖励函数指定方法
translated_abstract: 让人类利益相关者能够指定带来期望结果的奖励函数，是部署强化学习智能体的一个关键挑战。基于偏好的方法（如在线RLHF）可以减轻手动奖励设计的负担，但它们需要反复训练策略、从真实世界采样轨迹并获取反馈，这在环境交互计算代价高昂或不安全的场景中并不实用。我们提出了无经验自主奖励规范方法，这是一种无需环境交互即可从偏好中学习奖励函数的方法。我们的方法使用结构化的LLM中介流程，从任务描述和环境观测空间中构建一小组富有表现力的奖励特征，然后在该特征空间中策略性地采样想象轨迹，并从对想象轨迹对的偏好中学习特征权重。
tldr: 提出了EARS方法，利用LLM从任务描述构建奖励特征，并通过在想象轨迹上的偏好学习特征权重，实现无需环境交互的强化学习奖励函数设计。
en_tdlr: EARS enables reward function specification for RL without environment interaction by using LLMs to construct reward features and learning feature weights from preferences over imagined trajectories.
